questions.question: Where is the code that connects to the different AI vendors and streams the chat reply back piece by piece?
questions.note: llmProviders defines one streaming provider class per vendor plus the factory; chatRelay picks the provider and appends streamed chunks to the chat.

questions.question: Where is the button that exports the rendered agreement preview to a PDF file implemented?
questions.note: MainContainer has the Download PDF button and the html2pdf export handler that forces a white background.

questions.question: Where does the data model editor define the keyword and type highlighting for the modeling language?
questions.note: ConcertoEditor registers the concerto language with Monaco and its Monarch tokenizer keyword and type lists.

questions.question: Where does the Learn section get the text for its tutorial modules, and where is the order of the modules defined?
questions.note: fetchContent downloads the module markdown from GitHub, steps lists the module order, Content renders it with previous and next navigation.

questions.question: How does the playground turn the template text, the data model and the sample JSON into the live HTML preview?
questions.note: The debounced rebuild in the store validates inputs, builds the model manager, runs the template interpreter and transforms the result to HTML.

questions.question: How is the AI provider API key protected when it is saved in the browser?
questions.note: secureKeyStorage encrypts the key with AES-GCM derived from a WebAuthn PRF credential; AIConfigSection falls back to memory-only when unsupported.

questions.question: How do the AI inline code suggestions in the editors avoid sending a request on every keystroke?
questions.note: autocompletion waits one second, checks last editor activity, and enforces an in-flight flag plus a two second gap between requests.

questions.question: How does clicking an error in the problems list move the cursor to the right line in the right editor?
questions.note: ProblemPanel parses source, line and column from error text; editorNavigation keeps a registry of editors and reveals and highlights the line.

questions.question: What happens when someone opens a shared playground link: how is the encoded state read from the address and restored into the editors?
questions.note: App reads the hash or legacy query data, the store loadFromLink decompresses and fills editors and compiles logic, compression wraps LZString.

questions.question: What happens after a user presses Send Request on a contract with logic, until the response, state and events appear in the results tabs?
questions.note: The button calls triggerContract, which posts compiled code to the sandbox iframe; SandboxFrame routes the result back to the pending resolver.

questions.question: What Node.js version is required, and which commands start the dev server and run the unit and browser tests?
questions.note: README lists Node 22 or newer and the dev, unit test, e2e and build commands; DEVELOPERS covers setup and the testing guide.

questions.question: What commit message format and sign-off do maintainers expect on contributions?
questions.note: These docs require type(scope): description messages with a DCO Signed-off-by line, and the PR checklist repeats it.
